Consent_Form.label: Aim and target of research Hello. My name is ________ and I work with Research Solutions. We are currently doing a study to assess turmeric quality concerns and to develop solutions that will help the industry ensure the availability of high quality spices. Why are we inviting you to participate in the study? This study is primarily based on interviews with consumers and retailers of turmeric. We are inviting you to participate in this research because you are a consumer/retailer of turmeric and are knowledgeable about issues related to spices and spice quality. Methods and procedures If you agree to participate, we will talk to you for around 15 minutes. We would ask you some questions related to your turmeric purchase or consumption. We ask that we speak with you in a comfortable private location so you can openly share your opinions and knowledge. Risk and benefits There is no more than minimal risk related to your participation in this study. There is a potential inconvenience since you would need to spare time from your daily life to participate in the interviews. There is no direct monetary compensation benefit for participating in this study. But the information you are giving has certain benefits since it may contribute to improving the wellbeing of your community and country. Privacy, anonymity and confidentiality We will not collect any identifiable data about you like your name, address, or phone number. We will combine data from all interviews into aggregate findings and the information you share will NOT be linked back to you. Right not to participate and withdraw Your participation in the study is voluntary, and you have the right to refuse in any part, including answering specific questions. You can drop out of this study at any time, even in the middle of an interview with no consequences. We will withdraw your permission and if you wish, we will destroy all the data from the database. You have the right to refuse participation in this study. Principle of compensation You need not pay us to take part in this study, and similarly we will not pay you money for participating in the study. Persons to contact If you have any questions, you can ask me any time, we will happily provide you with further information now or later. You may communicate with the designated person below. [Name: Majid Khan (Field Head Manager) and contact number: +92321-3744666 of Research Solutions designated person]. Do you consent to be interviewed?
